# Twahanur Rahman - Full Developer Profile & AI Reference

## Overview
Twahanur Rahman is a Full-Stack Web Developer and Software Engineer with extensive experience in architecting modern web platforms, multi-tenant SaaS applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, and AI integrations.

## Core Competencies
- Web Applications: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Responsive Web Design, SSR & SSG Optimization
- Server & APIs: NestJS, Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, Microservices, WebSockets
- Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis Caching, MongoDB, Prisma, TypeORM
- Infrastructure: Docker, Cloudflare Workers, CI/CD Pipelines, Linux Server Administration
- Artificial Intelligence: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM Application Development, Embedding Generation, Vector Search
